or failure by such a company or enterprise to comply with the time limits within which it must terminate a bank account agreement or a bank deposit agreement with a credit institution that does not meet the requirements established for those purposes by regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation and is not included in the lists of credit institutions posted by the Bank of Russia on the Internet information and telecommunications network in accordance with the provisions of those federal laws, and (or) the time limits within which it must terminate a bank account agreement or a bank deposit agreement with a foreign bank that does not meet the requirements established for those purposes by regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation and is not included in the lists of foreign banks posted by the federal executive body responsible for developing state policy and regulatory legal regulation in the field of banking on the Internet information and telecommunications network in accordance with the provisions of those federal laws; or failure to comply with the procedure and conditions established by regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation for the disposal of securities of credit institutions belonging to such a company or enterprise, —

units.locator: Article 15.39. Violation of requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation concerning the opening of a bank account and a letter of credit with a credit institution and the conclusion of a bank deposit agreement by a business company and a federal unitary enterprise of strategic importance to the defence industry and security of the Russian Federation; the opening of a bank or other account with a credit institution and the conclusion of a bank deposit agreement by a state corporation, a state company and a public-law company; and the conclusion of a bank deposit agreement with the Federal Treasury or state extra-budgetary funds (territorial compulsory medical insurance funds)
units.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on officials of one hundred thousand to one million roubles; and on legal entities, of ten million to sixty million roubles.
